symptom: sed and awk output lost every CR byte; CRLF files would turn LF on the whole file
cause: Git Bash sed and gawk open files in text mode on Windows
correction: sed -b and awk -v BINMODE=3 everywhere; printf "%s%s", out, RT keeps the exact terminator
lesson: on Windows every text tool runs in binary mode or it rewrites line endings

cause: gawk substr(s, 0, 1) returns the first character, not ""; the token saw itself as its predecessor
correction: explicit i == 1 test before looking at the previous character
lesson: never read position 0 in gawk; guard the first column

symptom: a failing awk would have replaced the source file with its partial output
cause: the driver installed tmp over the file whenever cmp differed
correction: install only when the tool exits 0 and the line count is unchanged; otherwise REFUSED on stderr
lesson: a text recipe never trusts an output it did not validate

symptom: the fast driver stopped at the first bundle with no `_` file
cause: grep exits 1 on no match; pipefail + set -e ended the whole run
correction: { grep ... || true; } before the while loop
lesson: every grep feeding a pipeline under set -e needs `|| true`

symptom: the self-test compared literal \n and \r text, not bytes
correction: printf '%b' for input and expected output
lesson: tests compare bytes; build fixtures with %b

symptom: FILE_MARKS rows had only the path, one record held the whole input
cause: awk -v RS=... set the record separator, not a variable named RS
lesson: never name an awk -v variable after a built-in (RS, FS, NR, NF, OFS, ORS, RT)

symptom: gate rows carried native S:\ paths, the README and marks could not join them
cause: javac prints native paths on Windows
correction: tr '\\' '/' and strip the worktree prefix; existing gate files normalised the same way so the differential stays consistent
lesson: normalise tool output paths before any join; change old and new outputs together

symptom: jdt.ui residue showed 0 while 5 collisions existed
cause: awk NR == FNR with an empty first file treats every row of the second file as the first file
correction: read the side list in BEGIN with getline
lesson: the NR == FNR idiom breaks on an empty first file

cause: MSYS path conversion rewrites arguments that start with /
lesson: set MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 for any argument that is not a Windows path

symptom: pass-two rows of files with spaces in the path lost their line numbers
cause: git appends a tab to +++ header names that contain spaces
correction: strip a trailing tab from the header path
lesson: diff headers are not plain paths; trim them

symptom: javac --release 21: variable unused is already defined
cause: nested lambdas both had `_`; renaming gave both the same name
correction: collision pass driven by the gate residue: rename_at.awk gives the declaration the smallest unusedN absent from the file
lesson: a rename recipe needs a scope-aware second pass; let the compiler find the scopes

symptom: 13 parse errors in SwitchTest.java in the --release 21 run only
cause: the file starts with a UTF-8 BOM; javac rejects it and its parser recovery differs between source levels
correction: files javac rejects for a BOM in the baseline are left out of the residue
lesson: a differential gate must exclude inputs the oracle cannot read

symptom: a process check reported a running recipe that was not running
cause: ps | grep matched the checking command's own command line
correction: match the process command name, not the shell line that contains it
lesson: before replacing a script in use, check the process table by exact command

symptom: about 0.3 s per Java file: an hour for jdt.ui
cause: one awk process per file, and almost every Java file contains `_` in a constant name
correction: one grep -r -l -Z per bundle selects files with a standalone `_` token
lesson: prefilter with one grep per tree, spawn per-file tools only for hits
